commit.message:
Draw soreness stripe day boundaries as seams, not gaps

A stripe was one rect per logged day, each inset a pixel top and bottom
with rounded corners, so every day boundary opened a ~2px window onto the
page background. The spawn connectors are drawn behind the stripes, so a
connector crossing a lane showed through those windows and read as if it
terminated in the stripe rather than passing under it.

Stripes are now one shape per unbroken run of days, with the boundaries
drawn on top of the fill as an opaque seam in a darker cast of the day's
own colour, plus a matching outline around the run. Days still read as
cells in a bar — that segmentation is what makes the length countable —
but the separation is paint, so nothing can pass through it. The per-day
rects survive as invisible hit targets over the fill, so a click still
opens exactly one date's entry and a hover still names one day.

Bridged (unlogged) days merge into a single thin bar for the same reason:
a run of them used to draw as a row of ticks, when the narrowing is meant
to read as one constriction.

Connectors also now land on the middle of their first day instead of on
its top edge. That edge is exactly where a boundary seam sits, so a
workout spawning mid-run and a day boundary were drawing the same mark at
the same height.
